## Review Corrections batch (cold review, 2026-09-09) — all applied, STRICT TDD

- Blocker 1 (fail-open gate): providers/github.mjs:620 and providers/gitlab.mjs:1178 used
  `requiredReviews > 0`, false for null/NaN/-1 — armed on all three. Fixed to `!== 0` (exact
  zero only). New contract test proved RED (2 provider cases fail) before fix, GREEN after.
  spec.md requirement rewritten; vcs-contract.draft.md row wording updated; planAmendment
  re-verified unchanged output.
- Correction 3 (todo provenance gate): github unsupported todo test now asserts
  fixture._provenance.recorded === true — confirmed currently fails against the placeholder
  (derived:true) fixture, exactly as designed. Stays todo.
- Correction 4 (never-throws holes): gitlab.mjs assumed thrown value was an Error — string
  rejection lost `error` key, null rejection threw TypeError on `.message`. Fixed with
  `err?.message ?? String(err)`. github.mjs had no try/catch around gh() — throwing seam
  rejected the promise; wrapped in try/catch, same extraction. New throwingArgs case
  (replacing the old duplicate-of-transportArgs "never throws" test) + 2 gitlab standalone
  tests (string reject, null reject). RED before fix, GREEN after.
- Editorial 5: dead unsupportedArgs table entries wired into the two standalone unsupported
  tests instead of left unused; gitlab's unsupportedArgs gained optional status param.
- Editorial 6: added `assert.ok(AUTO_MERGE_REASON_VALUES.includes(reason))` to every
  refused/unsupported/transport case, matching design.md's test-map row 6 (was aspirational,
  never shipped).
- Editorial 7: source guard regex tightened `\s+` → `\s*` (catches compact `enabled:true`),
  filtering out JSDoc comment-body lines (trim().startsWith('*')) first so @returns type
  annotations stay unmatched. Verified via out-of-suite sanity check that the tightened regex
  actually catches a compact hand-construction.
